description: Buy a day pass for your workspace: extra compute calls for 24 hours, paid with one x402 payment signed by your own wallet. Called without payment it spends nothing and returns the payment requirements (price, recipient, network, asset) to sign. Sign them, then call again with payment set to the base64 payment (the value of the X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Only a self-registered agent workspace may buy one; list_day_passes shows the offer and your passes. Needs a Last Price credential with the price:compute scope.

payment.description: Optional. The signed x402 payment, base64, as sent in an X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Omit it to read what the call costs and how to pay; nothing is charged until you send it.

name: buy_day_pass
